dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: Want to sign up? Make sure your paperwork is all in order.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: ...For a job where you can complete our commissions. Think it's your speed?

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: Goodbye. If you change your mind, I'll be right here.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: We are simply hiring "people who can complete commissions." If you get the work done, we'll see that you are paid.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: Simply complete the commission. How you achieve those ends is irrelevant.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: ...We do not have any mention of such in our relevant notices at present.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: However, everyone who completes their commissions will receive their pay in the end... As long as they return alive, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: I will sign a short-term contract with you on behalf of the Fatui, during which I shall be the sole representative in charge of our correspondences.

dialogues.speaker: Kruchek
dialogues.text: The contractual obligations of both parties are only valid for the commission's duration. They will not affect any other business you may have outside the bounds of our contract.
